g.text: An agent pays a recipient set to Always
payment: Idle → Queued → Signed → Sent → Included → Confirmed (C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C11, C12, C21)
One commit, C3 order: wallet ready; Mara on for it; tool on (allowedAs);
arguments; identity; wallet can sign now; rule: no Deny(wallet, Ana),
Always(Mara, wallet, 0x12ab…) covers it, amount not bound;
available = balance at block b − reservations − fee reserve ≥ 5 (C11).
row: Idle · call [wallet_usable and payer == 'agent' and eff == 'always' and fits] → Queued
Re-checks: I still Queued, not refused by a cancel or a Deny sweep;
C3 steps 1, 2, 6, 7, 8 against the rules as they are now;
Takes nonce n = ledger.next, appends version {raw, keccak256(raw)},
I → Signed. Synced per commit before any broadcast (C21).
row: Queued · start_commit [not ledger_moved and start_ok and fits] → Signed
[poll 2 s while awaited (a logs subscription where offered)]
row: Included · finality [blk_fin and blk_ok] → Confirmed (Settle)
Always pays its recipient whatever amount, up to what is in the wallet: the balance is the cap (requirement 2).
A status-0 receipt, proven from two sources (C7), gives Failed at finalized (Included · finality [blk_fin and not blk_ok] → Failed); a reorg gives
Included · reorg → Sent and the stored bytes are rebroadcast (C12). The absence of a receipt never ends a payment.
